title: The mutational dynamics of the Arabidopsis centromeres
title_zh: 拟南芥着丝粒的突变动力学
abstract: Abstract Centromeres are essential for faithful chromosome segregation during cell division. Yet despite their conserved function, many centromeres contain highly variable but internally remarkably homogenized tandem-repeat arrays 1–5 whose evolutionary dynamics remain poorly understood. Here, using replicated genome assemblies of mutation accumulation lines, we define the centromere-specific mutation spectrum in Arabidopsis thaliana . We find that kilobase-sized insertion–deletion mutations (indels) occur frequently and consistently preserve tandem-repeat arrays by adding or removing only complete repeat units. Point mutations accumulate at an almost tenfold higher rate than elsewhere in the genome, probably driven by non-allelic gene conversion between closely linked repeat units. These findings suggest a central role for homology-directed DNA repair in centromere evolution, further supported by the accumulation of more frequent and longer tandem-repeat-preserving indels in Arabidopsis lines that are deficient in the anti-recombinase helicase RTEL1. Forward-in-time simulations parameterized with the observed mutation spectrum show that kilobase-sized indels and point mutations alone are sufficient to generate the megabase-sized homogenized repeat blocks characteristic of natural centromeres. Together, our results show that centromere evolution is driven by a distinct mutational spectrum shaped by homology-directed DNA repair, providing a quantitative framework for understanding how mutational processes generate and maintain the large-scale architecture of centromeric DNA.
abstract_zh: 摘要 着丝粒对于细胞分裂期间染色体的忠实分离至关重要。尽管其功能高度保守，许多着丝粒却包含高度可变但内部极度同质化的串联重复序列1–5，其进化动力学仍不清楚。本文利用突变积累系的重复基因组装，定义了拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）着丝粒特异性的突变谱。结果显示，千碱基大小的插入缺失（indel）突变频繁发生，并通过仅添加或删除完整的重复单元来持续保持串联重复序列。点突变的累积速率几乎是基因组其他部位的十倍，可能由紧密相连的重复单元之间的非等位基因转换驱动。这些发现提示同源性导向的 DNA 修复在着丝粒进化中起核心作用，进一步通过在缺乏抗重组解旋酶 RTEL1 的拟南芥系中观察到更频繁、更长的保持串联重复的 indel 来得到支持。基于观察到的突变谱进行的前向时间模拟表明，千碱基大小的 indel 与点突变单独就足以产生自然着丝粒所特有的大规模同质化重复块。综上所述，我们的结果表明，着丝粒进化受一种由同源性导向 DNA 修复塑造的独特突变谱驱动，为理解突变过程如何生成并维持着丝粒 DNA 大尺度结构提供了定量框架。
